results.title: Nebraska's Matt Rhule talks fourth-down gamble, one regret from Indiana loss
results.description: A fourth-down gamble didn’t go Nebraska’s way as the Indiana game slipped away Saturday. Upon review, coach Matt Rhule said he would make the same call again.
